p: Before a journal entry aggregation job runs, reports that read aggregated tables require a null check because those tables contain no data yet.

Refund and Provisional Credit postings record cash-out transactions against specific accounts and credit the same suspense account. The debit account depends on the transaction type and the number of Y flags.

Good Will postings record fee and principal adjustments without moving cash. The debit account depends on the charge type, while the credit account depends on whether the posting includes the Y indicator.

p: Scheduled Payment postings record cash movements for principal, late fees, NSF fees, snooze fees and unallocated credit using fixed general ledger account pairs.

p: Charge Off Principal postings map credit and debit rows to general ledger accounts under Separate GL Rule, depending on whether the charge off is classified as fraud or non fraud. All charge off rows use Batch Type Code 5 and Batch Alpha Code Blank.
